preparations.title: Smoky Harissa Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Toss the chicken thighs with harissa, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Spread on a single oven tray and roast at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until charred and cooked through.

preparations.title: Slow-Simmered BBQ Chickpeas
preparations.method: Sauté the onion in oil until soft. Add tomato puree, paprika, and drained chickpeas. Stir in the maple syrup and a splash of water, then simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until thick and smoky.

preparations.title: Herby Fluffy Quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse quinoa and boil in stock for 15 minutes. Let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.

preparations.title: Charred Courgettes and Sweetcorn
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Sauté courgettes and corn on high heat until charred and tender. Stir in garlic for the last 2 minutes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven and get the chicken roasting on the single tray. While it cooks, start the quinoa on the stovetop. Dice the onion and garlic, then start the slow-simmered chickpeas in a small pot. Finally, char the courgettes and corn in a large pan. Chop the parsley and fluff the quinoa before boxing everything up.
